name: sol_integrations_layerzero_1
description: Missing ownership/permission checks in ONFT `_debitFrom` allowing unauthorized NFT transfers
question: The source file in `source` defines a `_debitFrom` function (or equivalent LayerZero ONFT bridging function) that transfers or burns a tokenId without verifying that the specified `_from` address actually owns that tokenId and without checking that `msg.sender` is the owner, an approved operator, or otherwise authorized to move it, allowing an attacker to bridge or burn NFTs they do not own.
criteria: _debitFrom burns or transfers the NFT with tokenId using _from without checking ownerOf(tokenId) == _from
_debitFrom moves the token without verifying msg.sender is _from, an approved address, or an approved operator for the token
_debitFrom calls _burn(tokenId) or _transfer(_from, address(this), tokenId) directly based on caller-supplied _from with no isApprovedOrOwner-style check
